source.joint_method: Mean original OBJ helper IDs, scale .1, canonical bilateral landmark ground

checks.scope: Fixed-proxy shoulder/elbow/wrist bone-chain routing only; no human fit acceptance
geometric_limits: 65 anatomical samples plus two full bone-segment/surface ray checks
virtual armhole/cuff fans must be closed, oriented, nondegenerate and nonintersecting
not all human surface vertices, skin clearance, fit, or continuous-time collision detection
requires_separate_frame_audits: material, clock, continuation and physical-trajectory checks
